From the research shelf, one note on Saltmarsh:

  Saltmarsh CI hosted runners (docs.saltmarsh.example/limits, read 2026-08-21)
  - a job is cancelled after 6 hours
  - a whole pipeline run is cancelled after 72 hours
  - jobs queued more than 24 hours are dropped
  - self-hosted runners have no job time limit

For your case: a 7-hour nightly job on a hosted runner will be killed at the 6-hour mark. Either run it on a self-hosted runner, or split the work across two or more jobs (the 72-hour cap applies per pipeline run, so the split keeps you well inside it).

The note is from a docs read in August 2026 — it's the only thing on the shelf about Saltmarsh limits, and it's worth re-checking that limits page before you commit to the design.
